pages.title: Void Essence
pages.text: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled. Light falls into it and does not come out; air slides around it. It feels like a cold hole in my hand, and it is lighter than nothing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first Void Wraith I defeated left this behind, a small region of emptiness the air would not enter. I scooped it into a jar and it stayed there, quietly refusing everything.

Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Dark Matter Lens, Empty Set, Hollowing Ward.
